QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] A Legendary Legacy
QuestInfo.0: #p9073024# has something to tell you. It sounds kind of serious.
QuestInfo.1: #p9073024# has something to tell you. It sounds kind of serious.
QuestInfo.2: Holy moly! So the Silent Crusade is actually part of the Alliance! But this information is top secret, so you can't even share it with anyone. Drats!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 2,277,740\r\nCan proceed to the '[Silent Crusade] A Superior Hunter' quest\r\n

0.0: Now, you're probably wondering why I made you endure ALL of those trials. Well, you can blame #p9073005#. He said you had unparalleled skill, and I had to see it for myself.\r\n#L0##bWait, so was this all some sort of test?#l\n#k
0.1: Something like that, but it's not like you weren't rewarded for each task you performed. \r\n#L0##bAnything else you want to tell me?!#l\n#k
0.2: Well, I suppose I should tell you the origins of the Silent Crusade. We were originally a secret organization formed by the Empress, many generations ago. \r\n#L0##bWhoa, whoa, whoa. Is the Silent Crusade part of the Maple Alliance?#l\n#k
0.3: Indeed. Our job is the collect intel on the Black Mage and to prevent disasters before they happen. We needed you to eliminate #o9300514# inside of the #p9073008# because #p9073005# found traces of the Black Mage at the Lion King's Castle. He's still there, investigating. Hey, you're not planning to share this info with anyone, are you? It's top secret.

yes.0: Other than #p9073005# and me, few other members know about this. So be proud of everything you've done.

no.0: That's not funny. You ARE joking, aren't you?
